title: Dependency-aware selective tool knowledge adaptation
selection_rule: Official chosen_idx tasks whose servers run locally without paid accounts; task IDs fixed before evaluating policies. Development tasks are excluded. Subset emphasizes local file, project, task and memory workflows; not representative of all 201 tasks.
information_boundary: Updater receives tool contracts only, never questions, reference trajectories, task annotations or judge scores.
scope_rule: Use official task server/tool names at Early. Later include the same surviving names and newly added tools in those servers. Executable servers always use the current official version.
failure_policy: Preserve every failed trace. Invalid updates are rejected with previous knowledge retained and recorded. Infrastructure errors are reported separately and never silently omitted. Formal output directories are immutable on rerun.
judge_limitation: Local Qwen2.5-7B judge with unmodified official rubric, calibrated on two development trajectories. Scores are not instructor-certified and may still be incorrect; inspect independent execution evidence.
